notes: Agent-loop backlog. Pick the first story whose status is 'pending', refined is true, and every depends_on is 'done'. Statuses: pending | in_progress | blocked | done. Epics with refined=false must be split into stories (roadmap refinement) before work starts. Human-readable view: docs/product/roadmap.md.
definition_of_done: API endpoints covered by feature tests (Pest); OpenAPI contract in packages/api-contract updated
Web, admin and mobile UI built for every surface listed, with loading, empty, error and offline states
All user-facing strings go through i18n
Server-side authorisation on every new endpoint
Every acceptance criterion and referenced BR/U/R/AT check passes

increments.name: Foundation
increments.goal: All apps boot locally and in CI; health check end to end

increments.name: MVP: Farmer sells, buyer buys
increments.goal: Farmer signs up, pays (sandbox), is verified, builds a storefront and shares it; a buyer opens the link, buys with pickup, and the farmer fulfils

increments.name: Delivery + trust
increments.goal: Verified transporters quote, get assigned and prove delivery; inspection, disputes and reviews

increments.name: Suppliers + B2B procurement
increments.goal: Supplier catalogue; business RFQ to matched quotes to order

increments.name: Group buying + rescue
increments.goal: Group order via shared link with per-member payment; fixed-price rescue produce

increments.name: Jobs, consultants, markets
increments.goal: Job posts and private worker matching; verified consultant directory; market directory

stories.title: Scaffold Laravel API in apps/api
acceptance: Laravel app created in apps/api (remove .gitkeep first)
PostgreSQL connection and Redis queue configured from env
GET /v1/health returns 200 with app version and DB/queue status
Pest installed; a health feature test passes
Pint and Larastan configured

stories.title: Scaffold Next.js public web in apps/web
acceptance: Next.js App Router, TypeScript strict, Tailwind
i18n routing set up with English default and locale files ready for yo, ig, ha
A /health page calls the API health endpoint and shows status
ESLint, typecheck and a unit-test runner configured

stories.title: Scaffold Next.js admin console in apps/admin
acceptance: Separate Next.js app, TypeScript strict, Tailwind
Protected layout placeholder (auth arrives in I1-07)
Lint, typecheck and test runner configured

stories.title: Scaffold Expo app in apps/mobile
acceptance: Expo (managed) with Expo Router and TypeScript strict
i18n set up with English default
Deep-link scheme and universal/app link config placeholders for farmoga.com
Health screen calls the API
Lint, typecheck and Jest configured

stories.title: Local services and developer commands
acceptance: docker-compose.yml runs PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO (S3) and Mailpit
Makefile targets: up, down, api, web, admin, mobile, test, verify
.env.example lists every variable with no secrets
docs/runbooks/local-setup.md explains first-time setup

stories.title: OpenAPI contract and generated TypeScript client
acceptance: packages/api-contract/openapi.yaml describes /v1/health
packages/shared generates a typed client from the contract
web, admin and mobile use the shared client for the health call
CI fails when the contract and the generated client drift

stories.title: Design tokens shared by web, admin and mobile
acceptance: packages/design-tokens/tokens.json holds colours, type scale, spacing and radii (green brand from the prototype)
Tokens consumed by Tailwind (web, admin) and the mobile theme
Contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA

stories.title: CI workflows and verify script
acceptance: .github/workflows run lint, typecheck, tests and build per app, plus the contract check
harness/scripts/verify.sh runs the same gates locally and exits non-zero on failure
CI is green on main

stories.title: Agent harness and loop content
acceptance: Root CLAUDE.md: stack, commands, rules, where to find the PRD and backlog
harness/loop.md: pick, implement, verify, record, handoff
harness/init.sh and scripts/next-feature.sh work
.claude/settings.json, hooks, agents, commands and skills filled in
harness/open-questions.md lists the PRD questions Q1-Q12

stories.title: Registration with phone/email OTP and consent
acceptance: Register with phone (primary) or email; OTP verifies the contact
Terms and privacy consent is required and stored (who, what, when, policy version); marketing opt-in is separate and optional
Rate limits on registration and OTP send/verify
OTP provider sits behind an interface with a log driver for local and test

stories.title: Login, sessions and role assignment
acceptance: Login and logout on web (cookie session) and mobile (token in secure storage)
A user can hold farmer and buyer roles; roles are checked server-side
Rate-limited login

stories.title: Preserve deep-link destination through signup and login
acceptance: Opening a protected action from /farm or /product returns the user to the same page and action after signup or login
Works on web and from a mobile deep link

stories.title: Plans endpoint and pricing UI
acceptance: GET /v1/plans returns Quarterly ₦30,000 / 3 months, Half-yearly ₦54,000 / 6 months, Annual ₦95,000 / 12 months, with benefits
Pricing section on the landing page and in farmer onboarding

stories.title: Subscription checkout and verified webhook activation
acceptance: Payment gateway behind an interface with a fake driver; the real sandbox driver is added once Q2 is answered
Checkout starts a payment; the success screen never activates anything
The webhook verifies signature, amount, currency, plan and owner; unique provider event IDs make replays no-ops
Entitlement activates only from the webhook

stories.title: Entitlement ledger, calendar expiry and expired state
acceptance: Ledger keyed on paid_until; every change recorded (payment, renewal, refund, admin adjustment with reason)
Expiry uses calendar months, never fixed day counts
Early renewal starts at the current paid_until; after expiry the new term starts at payment time
A scheduled job moves subscriptions to expiring and expired; expired hides listings without deleting them
Renewal prompts show only for paid roles

stories.title: Admin login with MFA, RBAC sub-roles and audit log
acceptance: Separate admin accounts with TOTP MFA
Sub-roles admin.super, admin.verification, admin.finance, admin.support enforced server-side
Audit events (actor, action, target, time, before/after) for every admin action
Admin can view users, subscriptions and payments

stories.title: Farmer verification submission and admin review queue
acceptance: Farmer submits farm details and documents; files go to private encrypted storage
Reviewers open documents through short-lived signed URLs only
Approve, reject with reason, or request more info; the farmer is notified
Verified badge appears only when approved

stories.title: Farmer profile and storefront with five category tabs
acceptance: Profile: farm name, locality, bio, operating hours, cover image and logo
Unique slug, with suggestions on conflict
Five category tabs from business-type templates; renaming remaps listings
Storefront is public only when the entitlement is active and the farmer is verified

stories.title: Product listing create, edit and stock updates
acceptance: Fields: photos (compressed and resized), section, category, storefront tab, unit, price, quantity, pickup location, availability state and dates
Each stock or availability change records who and when; 'last confirmed' is shown
Unlimited listings; image upload failure is handled

stories.title: Farmer dashboard with Share my storefront
acceptance: Summary cards: active listings, orders, subscription expiry
Quick actions: Add product, View orders, Share my storefront (copy link, WhatsApp, native share)
States: new account, incomplete verification, expired subscription

stories.title: Landing page and role selection
acceptance: Hero, value proposition, role cards (farmer, buyer for now), pricing, browse entry, footer
Loading skeleton, network failure and mobile menu states

stories.title: Server-rendered /farm/{slug} and /product/{id} with share previews
acceptance: SSR pages with canonical HTTPS URLs and Open Graph title, image and description
Copy link, WhatsApp prefilled text and native share (copy fallback on desktop)
Shows current price and stock; browsable without an account or app install
Mobile opens the same content from the link when the app is installed

stories.title: Unavailable and expired content page
acceptance: Removed, expired, moderated or entitlement-expired content shows an informative page with alternatives
Never redirects to the generic homepage while the content exists

stories.title: Marketplace browse and search
acceptance: Search by keyword with section, category and location filters
Cards show price per unit, quantity, location and last confirmed
Only public, entitled, verified listings appear; no-results state

stories.title: Buy Now with atomic stock reservation
acceptance: Buyer chooses quantity and pickup; the order total shows product subtotal and fees
Stock is reserved atomically; concurrent checkouts cannot oversell (concurrency test)
Unpaid reservations expire and release stock
Price change during checkout makes the buyer re-confirm

stories.title: Order payment and order state machine
acceptance: Order payment uses the gateway interface from I1-05; confirmation only via verified webhook
States created → payment_pending → confirmed → preparing → ready_for_pickup → delivered, plus cancelled and refunded; every transition audited
Refund webhook moves the order to refunded and releases stock where applicable

stories.title: Farmer order management (pickup flow)
acceptance: Farmer sees incoming orders, confirms, marks preparing, ready for pickup, and handed over
Buyer confirms collection; order becomes delivered
Only the order's farmer and buyer can view it

stories.title: In-app notifications for orders and subscription
acceptance: Inbox with unread count; mark as read
Events: new order, order status change, verification decision, subscription activated, expiring, expired
Notifications are queued and sent after commit

stories.title: I1 end-to-end demo and mobile parity check
acceptance: Scripted demo on staging with seed data: farmer signup, pay, verify, storefront, share, buyer buys with pickup, farmer fulfils
Every I1 screen works on mobile and web
U01, U13, U14, R01, R10, R12, AT01, AT05 (stock), AT09 recorded as passing in docs/acceptance

stories.title: Transporter onboarding, documents and admin verification
Transport quote requests, bids, acceptance and assignment with capacity guard
Delivery status timeline and proof of delivery
Delivery inspection and dispute cases
Verified reviews, moderation and review appeals
Supplier onboarding, verification, storefront /supplier/{slug} and catalogue
Enquiry to supplier quote flow
Business buyer profile and RFQ publishing
Matching engine and seller demand alerts
Quote responses, comparison and order creation
Create, share (/group/{id}) and join group orders; farmer approves pickup
Per-member payment, funding rules, cancellation and proportional refunds
Rescue listings with condition disclosure and fixed-price checkout
Job posts (/jobs/{id}) by paid employers, browse and apply
Private worker profiles and anonymous matching with contact approval
Consultant application, credential review and public directory
Market suggestions, moderation, reports and area alerts
Live payment gateway, SMS/OTP, email, push and opt-in WhatsApp
Security review, fraud tests and performance tests
Production deploy, monitoring, backups and restore drill
Android/iOS build readiness, full UAT run and handover package

out_of_scope: Invite & Share module, referral codes and links, referral history, Membership Rewards and referral reward rules (PRD §14)
